description:
Open the dataset '~/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv' in Jamovi. This dataset contains responses to the Big Five Inventory (BFI) personality items. Perform a Reliability Analysis on the five Extraversion items: E1, E2, E3, E4, and E5. 

IMPORTANT: Items E1 ('Don't talk a lot') and E2 ('Find it difficult to approach others') are negatively worded compared to the other Extraversion items and MUST be reverse-coded in the analysis settings. 

Configure the analysis to:
1. Include items E1, E2, E3, E4, E5.
2. Set E1 and E2 as 'Reverse Scaled Items'.
3. Enable 'Scale descriptives' to show the mean and standard deviation.

Save the Jamovi project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/Extraversion_Reliability.omv'. 
Also, create a text file report at '~/Documents/Jamovi/reliability_report.txt' containing:
- The Cronbach's α (alpha) value
- The Scale Mean
- The Scale Standard Deviation
